title: Gatchalian pushes for bill barring public officials' kin from gov't contracts
summary: Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Wednesday highlighted the need to pass into law Senate Bill 1962 or the Government Contracting and Procurement Integrity Act to prevent corruption.
